svg.aria-label: How a vision model sees: a kernel slides over the pixels, feature maps go from edges to whole objects as resolution falls and channels rise, the detection head proposes nine candidate boxes, and non-maximum suppression keeps three
svg.title: How a Vision Model Sees
svg.text: IN GENERAL · NOT ANY ONE SYSTEM
PIXELS → CONVOLUTION → FEATURE MAPS → CANDIDATE BOXES → SUPPRESSION → LABELS
smaller and deeper at every layer
THE KERNEL NEVER GROWS · THE RECEPTIVE FIELD DOES, WHICH IS HOW A 3 x 3 WINDOW ENDS UP SEEING A WHOLE CAR
